## Activity

During January 2024, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 417 captures. This figure represents the activity reported for the month. The capture total provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results set out below.

## Image quality

Of the 417 captures, 22 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 5.3 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and are reported separately from the images that produced a grading outcome. The result should be monitored as part of routine site operations and image-quality review.

## Grading

Grading identified 98 referable results during January 2024. The median lag between capture and grading was 4 days. This measure summarises the time taken for images to progress from capture to a grading outcome. Together, the activity, image-quality and grading figures provide the monthly operational position for Harbour Eye Clinic.
